### Load libraries
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
```


### Load data
```{r}
setwd("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field")

survival <- read_xlsx("data/Survival/07102025.xlsx")
treat_key <- read_xlsx("data/treatment_key.xlsx")


survival$top_bottom <- substring(survival$bag, 4) 
survival$bag_num <- substr(survival$bag, start = 1, stop = 2)
survival$bag_num <- as.factor(survival$bag_num)
treat_key$bag_num <- as.factor(treat_key$bag_num)
survival <- left_join(survival, treat_key, by = "bag_num")

```

### Cumulative deaths
```{r}

survival <- survival %>%
  group_by(bag_num, top_bottom) %>%
  arrange(date)%>%
  mutate(cumulative_deaths = cumsum(dead)) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
means_cumdead <- survival %>%
  group_by(date, density, tide, top_bottom) %>%
  summarise(mean_cumdead = mean(cumulative_deaths, , na.rm = TRUE),
            std_error = sd(cumulative_deaths, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(length(cumulative_deaths)),
            .groups = 'drop')
```


```{r}
means_cumdead %>%
  filter(density == "D") %>%
ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean_cumdead, shape = top_bottom, color = tide)) +
   geom_point(size=3, position=position_dodge(0.05)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Mean cumulative dead oysters per bag") +
  #scale_color_manual(labels = c("Daily Control", "Daily", "Weekly Control", "Weekly"), values = c("blue", "red", "green", "purple"))+
  labs(color = "Density")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_cumdead-std_error, ymax=mean_cumdead+std_error), width=.2,
                 position=position_dodge(0.05))+
  theme_classic()
```
